approaches.name: Brute Force
approaches.explanation: Check every pair of numbers to see if they sum to the target.

approaches.name: Hash Map
approaches.explanation: Use a hash map to store seen numbers and their indices; for each number, check if its complement exists.

approaches.name: Two Pointers (Sorted)
approaches.space: O(1) extra (after sort O(n) for mapping)
approaches.explanation: If returning values or allowed to reorder, sort and use two pointers; mapping back to original indices adds complexity.
cons: Requires sorting or careful index mapping
